# axiz-core-time

Injectable clock, business calendar, holidays, cut-off times and due dates.

## Dependency

```xml
<dependency>
  <groupId>pe.axiz</groupId>
  <artifactId>axiz-core-time</artifactId>
</dependency>
```

The version is managed by `axiz-bom` (services inherit `axiz-parent-service`).

## Main types

| Type | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `BusinessCalendar` | Business-day calendar: weekend days, recurring holidays (same day every year) and one-off holidays. |
| `CutoffTime` | Daily cut-off: operations received at or after the cut-off, or on a non-business day, are processed on the next business day. |
| `DueDates` | Due-date calculation with business-day adjustment conventions. |
| `TimeSettings` | Time settings of a service. |

## Tests

Unit tests live in `src/test/java` and document the expected behavior; run them with `./mvnw -pl core/axiz-core-time verify`.
